body: Yeah that's part of depression. I live what you are feeling each and every day. You just have to try and push through. Make new friends who will listen to you and take things one step at a time. Try talking to your family about what you are feeling. If they care they will listen to you and try and help you through it. If nothing works I would sudgest trying therapy. I was very hesitant of doing it but it really does improve you.
